The '''"Thumper" under-barrel grenade launcher''' was an [[under-barrel grenade launcher]] manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] and sold for 2000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The weapon attachment was available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Behind the scenes==
The name may be a reference to the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/M79_grenade_launcher M79 grenade launcher], which American soldiers nicknamed the "Thumper" for its distinctive report.
